56: // restMapperResolver resolves user tokens to resource metadata using RESTMapper.
57: type restMapperResolver struct {
58: 	mapper meta.RESTMapper
59: }
60: 
61: // newRESTMapperResolver creates a resolver using the provided RESTMapper.
62: func newRESTMapperResolver(mapper meta.RESTMapper) *restMapperResolver {
63: 	return &restMapperResolver{mapper: mapper}
64: }
65: 
66: // resolve converts tokens (short names, resource names, kinds) into resource metadata list.
67: func (r *restMapperResolver) resolve(tokens []string) ([]resourceMeta, error) {
68: 	if len(tokens) == 0 {
69: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no resource tokens provided")
70: 	}
71: 
72: 	out := make([]resourceMeta, 0, len(tokens))
73: 	seen := map[schema.GroupVersionResource]struct{}{}
74: 	var unknown []string
75: 
76: 	for _, t := range tokens {
77: 		tok := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(t))
78: 		if tok == "" {
79: 			continue
80: 		}
81: 
82: 		m, err := r.resolveToken(tok)
83: 		if err != nil {
84: 			unknown = append(unknown, t)
85: 			continue
86: 		}
87: 
88: 		if _, dup := seen[m.GVR]; dup {
89: 			continue
90: 		}
91: 		seen[m.GVR] = struct{}{}
92: 		out = append(out, m)
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	if len(unknown) > 0 {
96: 		return nil, &unknownResourcesError{Tokens: unknown, Known: commonResourceHints()}
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	return out, nil
100: }
101: 
102: // resolveToken resolves a single token using the short name map and RESTMapper.
103: func (r *restMapperResolver) resolveToken(token string) (resourceMeta, error) {
104: 	// Try short name map first
105: 	if gvk, ok := shortNameMap[token]; ok {
106: 		return r.gvkToMeta(gvk)
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	// Try as a Kind name
110: 	titleCaser := cases.Title(language.English)
111: 	capitalizedToken := titleCaser.String(token)
112: 	mapping, err := r.mapper.RESTMapping(schema.GroupKind{Kind: capitalizedToken})
113: 	if err == nil {
114: 		return resourceMeta{
115: 			GVR:        mapping.Resource,
116: 			Kind:       mapping.GroupVersionKind.Kind,
117: 			Namespaced: mapping.Scope.Name() == meta.RESTScopeNameNamespace,
118: 		}, nil
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	return resourceMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown resource: %s", token)
122: }
123: 
124: // gvkToMeta converts a GVK to resourceMeta using the RESTMapper.
125: func (r *restMapperResolver) gvkToMeta(gvk schema.GroupVersionKind) (resourceMeta, error) {
126: 	mapping, err := r.mapper.RESTMapping(gvk.GroupKind(), gvk.Version)
127: 	if err != nil {
128: 		return resourceMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to get mapping for %v: %w", gvk, err)
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	return resourceMeta{
132: 		GVR:        mapping.Resource,
133: 		Kind:       mapping.GroupVersionKind.Kind,
134: 		Namespaced: mapping.Scope.Name() == meta.RESTScopeNameNamespace,
135: 	}, nil
136: }

138: // unknownResourcesError conveys which tokens failed and a subset of known tokens.
139: type unknownResourcesError struct {
140: 	Tokens []string
141: 	Known  []string
142: }
143: 
144: func (e *unknownResourcesError) Error() string {
145: 	return fmt.Sprintf("unknown resource tokens: %v; known examples: %v", e.Tokens, e.Known)
146: }
147: 
148: // commonResourceHints returns common resource tokens for error hints.
149: func commonResourceHints() []string {
150: 	return []string{
151: 		"po", "pods", "svc", "services", "cm", "configmaps",
152: 		"sts", "statefulsets", "pvc", "persistentvolumeclaims",
153: 		"secrets", "sa", "serviceaccounts", "lease", "leases",
154: 		"pdb", "poddisruptionbudgets", "role", "rolebinding",
155: 	}
156: }
